The brown rot fungi, a group of filamentous basidiomycetes, rapidly depolymerize the cellulose in wood without significant lignin removal. This type of decay differs sharply from white rot fungi which simultaneously degrade lignin and cellulose.

It is our intention to publish the work of this project in a timely fashion and we welcome collaborative interaction on the project and analysis.
